{{Quote|The holocrons contain the most closely guarded secrets of the Jedi Order.|[[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]]|<ref name="Holocron Heist" />}}
'''Jedi holocrons'''<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref> were [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] artifacts used to store information and teachings of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Holocron Heist" /> [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]]s were partially powered by [[the Force/Legends|the Force]] preventing non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals from opening them. Once opened, anyone&mdash;even non-Force-sensitives&mdash;could communicate with the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]].<ref name="EGTTF" /> Holocrons were stored within the [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vault]], located within the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Access to the Vault was only permitted to Jedi who currently served on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Holocron Heist" />
